follow-up time: 2 years before and after SBL implementation
exposure: Implementation of the Saving Babies Lives (SBL) Care Bundle
outcome: Proportion of small for gestational age infants detected
cohort: 463,630 births in 19 NHS Trusts in England
finding: Implementation of the SBL care bundle was associated with a reduction in stillbirth rates and increases in induction of labor, emergency Caesarean section, ultrasound scans, and detection of small for gestational age infants.
mod_finding: The study found an increase in emergency Caesarean sections associated with the SBL care bundle implementation.
